reason.auto: Best codec for this device and browser, picked at Connect
reason.autoChroma: Sharper takes full colour detail when both ends can do it
reason.chroma420: Colour at quarter resolution — the video default, decodes everywhere
reason.av1: Best quality per bit — hardware on both ends
reason.agentNoAv1: This device has no AV1 hardware encoder
reason.av1NoHw444: No hardware encoder can produce AV1 in 4:4:4
reason.hevc: Hardware H.265 on the device (NVENC / QSV / AMF / VideoToolbox / VAAPI / D3D12 / Vulkan)
reason.hevc444: Sharpest text on the hardware pipeline, ~1.5× bitrate
reason.browserNoHevc: This browser lacks a hardware HEVC decoder
reason.browserNoHevcRext: This browser can’t decode HEVC 4:4:4 (Chrome ≥137 with NVIDIA driver ≥572.16, or Intel Gen11+)
reason.agentNoHevc: This device has no HEVC encoder
reason.agentNoHevc444: This device has no HEVC 4:4:4 encoder (NVENC only today)
reason.browserNoVp9: This browser can’t decode VP9 profile 1
reason.agentNoVp9: This device has no VP9 encoder
reason.h264444: Sharpest text via H.264 High 4:4:4 — hardware encode, software decode
reason.browserNoH264High444: This browser can’t decode H.264 High 4:4:4
reason.agentNoH264_444: This device has no H.264 4:4:4 encoder (NVENC only today)
reason.vp9444hw: Sharpest text, ~1.5× bitrate — hardware encode (Intel), software decode
reason.failedBefore: Failed to decode on this browser earlier — retried after a browser or driver update
reason.no444Anywhere: No 4:4:4 cell exists for this device and browser

endedByHost.title: The person at the device ended the session.
endedByHost.body: They ended it from their screen (Disconnect, or their desktop's own Stop for screen sharing), so this viewer stays disconnected. Reconnect asks them again, as any new session does.

auth.heardAbout: How did you hear about Roomler?
auth.heardAboutHint: Optional. It tells us which channels work.

room.name: Room Name
room.noMessages: No messages yet. Start the conversation!

approval.notAccepted: The vault's policies do not accept your approval of this use

hive.title: Agent sessions
hive.adoptedExplain: A session you run in a terminal, mirrored here for you alone. It is read-only: nobody prompts it from Roomler.

empty.title: No agent sessions yet
empty.body: Start one on a device whose owner has turned agent sessions on (hive_enabled). It runs there, as the account the device maps you to, and its transcript stays on the device.

start.title: Start an agent session
start.folderHint: It must be inside one of the device's hive_roots.

viewer.truncated: The output was cut to the device's limit; its start and end are kept.
viewer.checkpoint: Checkpoint {n}: {changed} of {files} of the agent's files changed
viewer.unknownKind: An event this version cannot show ({kind}).

tool.tooLong: Too long to compare line by line.

viewer.askFailed: The prompt did not reach the agent.
viewer.readOnly: You can read this session and talk in its room. Only its drivers can prompt the agent.
viewer.adoptedReadOnly: This session runs in a terminal on its device, so it is read-only here: nobody prompts it from Roomler.
viewer.copyReadOnly: You are reading a copy another device holds, because the device that runs this session cannot serve it now. It is read-only: only that device takes prompts.
viewer.drivingRefused: You drive this session, but its device does not let you act there: {why}

approval.denyPlaceholder: Why not? (optional — the agent reads it)
approval.waiting: Waiting for one of the session's drivers to answer.
approval.expired: Nobody answered in time, so it did not run.
approval.failed: The answer did not reach the device.

people.title: Who takes part
people.explain: Drivers prompt the agent and answer its approvals. Readers read the session and talk in its room — nothing they write reaches the agent. Only the session's owner changes who takes part.
people.remove: Take them out of the session
people.adoptedReadersOnly: It runs in a terminal, so it takes readers only.

roomCopies.title: Copies of this session
roomCopies.explain: Each device listed holds a copy of this session, its transcript and checkpoints, so it stays readable, and can move, while the device it runs on is offline.

short.adopted: A session adopted from a terminal is copied nowhere but the device it runs on.
short.restricted: Fewer copies than the policy asks: a device that would hold one lacks a tag this session is restricted to.
short.no_device: Fewer copies than the policy asks: no other device offers to hold one.

step.joining: the device is taking its copy
step.draining: the device it runs on is finishing its turn

roomCopies.moveExplain: It stops where it runs and goes on there, from the copy that device holds. The copy that holds the most is picked: a move to one that holds less is refused.
roomCopies.folderHint: Where it runs on that device: the same folder unless you say otherwise.
roomCopies.ahead: {device} holds more of this session than any device it can move to: a move is refused until one catches up.
roomCopies.noTarget: No other device that runs sessions holds a copy yet.
roomCopies.adoptedStays: A session adopted from a terminal stays where it runs.

outcome.promoting: Moving: the device is ready, and the one it runs on is finishing its turn.
outcome.teleporting: Moving: the device is taking its copy while the session still runs.
outcome.pending: Asked: the device has not answered yet. Its room says how it goes on.

roomCopies.teleportExplain: Moves it to a device that holds no copy: that device takes one while the session still runs, then it moves there as a move to a copy does. The device it runs on must be online.
roomCopies.noTeleport: No other online device that runs sessions can take it.
roomCopies.forkExplain: Makes a new session from this one's conversation, in a folder of its own. This session goes on as it is.
roomCopies.forkFolderHint: Its own folder on that device: a fork cannot share the folder the session runs in.
roomCopies.noFork: No online device that runs sessions can make a fork.
roomCopies.adoptedNoFork: A session adopted from a terminal is not forked.
roomCopies.forkWhileMoving: It is being moved: fork it once it settles.

forkOutcome.accepted: Forked: the new session starts on that device.
forkOutcome.pending: Asked: the device has not answered yet. The fork's room says how it goes on.
forkOutcome.joining: Forking: the device is taking a copy first.

purge.title: Delete this session for good
purge.explain: "{title}" is deleted from every device that held it: where it runs, each copy, and where it ran before. On each, the account's part goes too, its history and its checkpoints, never the folder it worked in.
purge.atOnce: Its room, its core memory snapshot and its approvals are deleted at once. This cannot be undone.
purge.forksKeep: A session forked from it keeps its conversation up to its fork.
purge.going: Purging: {done} of {total} devices have answered. One offline is purged when it next connects.
purge.done: Purged from every device that held it.
purge.forks: Sessions forked from it keep its conversation up to their fork: {n}.
purge.pendingDetail: It is purged when it next connects.

closed.device_removed: The device was removed, and purged everything it held

manage.title: Make it a managed session
manage.explain: Its terminal session ended. Roomler can carry it on as a managed session on {device}: the same conversation, resumed from its terminal's own history, then run, copied and driven like any session started here.
manage.folderHint: Where its terminal ran, unless you name another
manage.lastRefused: Its device refused the last asking: {why}
manage.accepted: It is a managed session now, on {device}.
manage.pending: Asked. Its device has not answered yet: this room shows how it goes.

memory.title: Agent memory
memory.about: Facts kept here reach agent sessions as standing instructions. A session gets a copy when it starts and keeps that copy: a fact added later reaches the next session, not a running one. Only devices whose owner turned on hive_core_memory pass them to the agent.

scopeHint.org: Every session in the organization. Its administrators keep these.
scopeHint.device: Only sessions on that device. Device managers keep these.

memory.newFact: A fact the agent should know
memory.archive: Archive — out of every future session's memory

copies.title: Agent copies
copies.about: Each agent session runs on one device and is copied to the devices your organization's policy places it on, so it stays readable, and can move, while that device is offline. A copy is plaintext on the device that holds it.
copies.off: Sessions are not copied on this server: an operator turns on hive.replicaset.

policy.title: The policy
policy.copies: {min} to {max} copies of each session, its own device's among them
policy.archive: Archive replicas join every session the rules allow
policy.prefer: Then the session owner's own devices
policy.restricted: A session on a device tagged {tags} is copied only to devices with that tag
policy.retention: Kept {days} days after a session ends
policy.retentionForever: Kept for good after a session ends

rules.copiesHint: Copies of each session, its own device's among them: 1 to {max}
rules.maxBelowMin: At most is fewer than at least
rules.archive: Archive replicas join every session the rules allow
rules.prefer: Then the session owner's own devices
rules.restrictedHint: A session on a device with one of these tags is copied only to devices with that tag too. Press Enter to add one.
rules.retention: Days kept after a session ends
rules.retentionHint: 0 keeps it for good, and at most {max}
rules.retentionInvalid: A whole number of days, from 0 to {max}
rules.saved: Saved. The organization's live sessions are placed again under it.
rules.stale: The policy changed since you read it. It is shown as it is now: make your change again.

archive.title: Archive replicas
archive.hint: An always-on device of your organization that keeps a copy of every session the rules allow, for their retention, and serves a session while no other member is online. It runs no session. Your organization runs it, on its own machines.
archive.none: No device offers itself as an archive replica yet.
archive.unreadable: Until an archive replica is online, a session is readable only while one of its members is.
archive.offers: Offers itself as an archive replica
archive.notOffering: Does not offer itself: its owner turned hive_archive off, or it has not connected since
archive.gone: No longer a device of this organization
archive.stale: The policy changed since it was read. It is shown again: try once more.

add.title: Add an archive replica
add.intro: Run the archive replica image on a machine of your organization's that stays on. Its first start enrolls it with a token from here; every later start runs from its volume, and needs no token.
add.volume: The volume is the device: it holds the device's credentials and every session copied to it, in plaintext. Keep it as you would the sessions themselves.
add.hostname: Give the container a fixed hostname: the device's identity depends on it, and two archive replicas must not share one.
add.token: The token works once, for {minutes} minutes, and only the first start needs it.
add.next: Once it runs it appears under Archive replicas: turn on Designated to make it one.

search.label: Search the agent sessions you can read
search.hint: Searched on your organization's archive replica: what you type, and what it finds, never reach the server.
search.noRoom: That session has no room to open.

refused.not_found: Agent sessions cannot be searched in this organization.
refused.no_archive_replica: No archive replica that searches is online right now.
refused.no_session: The archive replica holds none of the sessions you can read yet.
refused.rate_limited: Too many searches were opened in the last minute. Wait a moment, then type again.
refused.too_many_views: This tab holds as many agent session peers as it may. Type again in a moment.
refused.device_unsupported: The archive replica runs a build that cannot search.
refused.no_answer: The archive replica did not answer.
refused.unavailable: The server could not prepare the search. Type again in a moment.
refused.at_capacity: The archive replica serves as many searches as it can right now.
refused.hive_disabled: The archive replica does not serve searches.

defaultPattern.label: Default pattern
defaultPattern.hint: What a viewer's Keep busy menu pre-selects on a device they have not set it on before. Circle unless you change it; a person's own last choice for a device wins over it.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every time keep busy was turned on or off on a device, as the device reported it, and every change to these settings. Kept permanently.

sourceHint.device: What the device itself reported on a heartbeat: a claim, seen at the 30-second heartbeat, never a server decision.
sourceHint.server: The server's own record of an admin's change.
